newsitem.title: LATVIA: OLAINFARM PROFIT SO FAR IN YR 330,000 LATS.
newsitem.headline: OLAINFARM PROFIT SO FAR IN YR 330,000 LATS.

text.p: Latvian pharmaceutical company Olainfarm said on Thursday that its after-tax profit in the first three months of its current financial year would reach around 330,000 lats and turnover would be 1.65 million lats, the company said on Thursday.
"Our profit for the second three months of this calendar year is expected to come close to 330,000 lats on turnover of 1.65 million lats," Egils Jurshevics, board chairman, told Reuters.
The company's financial year in 1997 started in April according to an agreement with the Latvian Privatisation agency, Jurshevics added.
The company wants to shorten its financial year to end at December, meaning a financial year of nine months. This still has to be agreed with the privatisation agency.
"The profit figure forecast might change insignificantly and if it does, it will be adjusted upwards. The exact figure can be expected around July 17," Jurshevics said.

"Olainfarm's volume of produced stock in average prices came to 4.33 million lats," Jurshevics added, noting that the companty was increasing its stocks ahead of the autumn months when sales usually go up.
The company earlier reported a first quarter loss of 1.62 million lats, which it said was due to one-off debt tax items worth 2.14 million lats.
The company said that its underlying profit in the first quarter of the calendar year was 500,000 lats.
